tEn: Lightning OPD 2.0: Mitigating Style Bias in Cross-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
tZh: Lightning OPD 2.0：缓解大型推理模型跨教师在线策略蒸馏中的风格偏差
sEn: Lightning OPD 2.0 removes style-token bias via cross-fitted style residualization, enabling effective on-policy distillation even when the SFT and distillation teachers differ.
sZh: Lightning OPD 2.0 通过交叉拟合风格残差化消除风格标记偏差，使得在 SFT 教师与蒸馏教师不同时仍能高效进行在线策略蒸馏。
absEn: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but its effectiveness can depend on teacher consistency, meaning that the model providing OPD supervision should also have generated the demonstrations used to train the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) reference. However, this condition is frequently violated in practice when SFT data have mixed or unknown provenance or when different models are preferred for SFT data generation and subsequent distillation. In such cross-teacher settings, even a stronger OPD teacher can yield little improvement over the SFT reference. We find that raw teacher--reference disagreement contains potentially useful context-specific teacher evidence as well as a recurring component associated with differences in wording, formatting, and reasoning cadence. We introduce Lightning OPD 2.0 with cross-fitted style residualization, which uses rollout-level cross-fitting to estimate this recurring component as an operational proxy for style-token bias and subtracts it before constructing the token-level OPD update. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, Lightning OPD 2.0 consistently outperforms Lightning OPD in cross-teacher settings. Starting from Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT, Lightning OPD 2.0 reaches 82.4% on AIME 2024 and 63.0% on LiveCodeBench v5. Together, these results establish Lightning OPD 2.0 as a practical approach to cross-teacher OPD, relaxing teacher consistency as a prerequisite and allowing the SFT data generator and distillation teacher to be selected independently. Code will be released soon.
absZh: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）从教师模型提供密集的令牌级监督，但其有效性可能依赖于教师一致性，即提供 OPD 监督的模型也应生成用于训练监督微调（SFT）参考的演示数据。然而，在实践中，当 SFT 数据来源混合或未知，或当 SFT 数据生成和后续蒸馏偏好使用不同模型时，这一条件经常被违反。在这种跨教师设置下，即使更强的 OPD 教师也可能相比 SFT 参考几乎没有改进。我们发现，原始教师-参考分歧既包含可能有用的上下文特定教师证据，也包含一个与措辞、格式和推理节奏差异相关的重复组成部分。我们引入了带有交叉拟合风格残差化的 Lightning OPD 2.0，该方法使用 rollout 级交叉拟合来估计这一重复组成部分，作为风格令牌偏差的操作性代理，并在构建令牌级 OPD 更新之前将其减去。在数学推理和代码生成基准测试中，Lightning OPD 2.0 在跨教师设置下 consistently 优于 Lightning OPD。从 Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT 出发，Lightning OPD 2.0 在 AIME 2024 上达到 82.4%，在 LiveCodeBench v5 上达到 63.0%。这些结果共同确立了 Lightning OPD 2.0 作为跨教师 OPD 的实用方法，放宽了教师一致性作为先决条件，并允许 SFT 数据生成器和蒸馏教师独立选择。代码即将发布。

contrib.en: Formulates the cross-teacher on-policy distillation setting where the SFT data generator and OPD teacher are chosen independently, showing substantial performance degradation.
contrib.zh: 提出跨教师在线策略蒸馏（cross-teacher OPD）设置：SFT 数据生成器与 OPD 教师独立选择，并证明该设置会带来显著的蒸馏性能下降。

contrib.en: Identifies a recurring cross-rollout component in teacher–reference disagreement tied to style-token bias, explaining why raw cross-teacher supervision can mislead.
contrib.zh: 识别出教师-参考模型分歧中可跨 rollout 预测的重复成分，并将其与风格 token 偏差相关联，解释原始跨教师监督为何会产生误导。

contrib.en: Introduces Lightning OPD 2.0 cross-fitted style residualization, estimating recurring style bias via token/context lookup tables and subtracting it before token-level OPD updates.
contrib.zh: 提出 Lightning OPD 2.0 的交叉拟合风格残差化：在 token 级 OPD 更新前，用 token 身份与上下文查找表估计并减去重复的风格偏差。

contrib.en: Outperforms Lightning OPD in two cross-teacher settings on math and code benchmarks, reaching 82.4% on AIME 2024 and 63.0% on LiveCodeBench v5.
contrib.zh: 在两个跨教师设置中，于数学推理与代码生成基准上超越 Lightning OPD，在 AIME 2024 上达到 82.4%，在 LiveCodeBench v5 上达到 63.0%。

contrib.en: Relaxes teacher consistency as an OPD prerequisite, decoupling SFT data generator and distillation teacher selection.
contrib.zh: 放宽教师一致性作为有效 OPD 的前提要求，使 SFT 数据生成器与蒸馏教师的选择解耦。

limits.en: Evaluation is limited to math/code tasks and Qwen-family models; generalization to other domains or model families is not established.
limits.zh: 评估仅限于数学/代码任务与 Qwen 系列模型；尚未验证对其他领域或模型族的泛化性。

limits.en: The style/reasoning decomposition is operational, not a ground-truth semantic partition; predictable effects may include non-style factors and residuals may retain style noise.
limits.zh: 风格/推理分解是操作性而非真实语义划分；可预测成分可能包含非风格因素，残差也可能保留风格噪声。

limits.en: Requires compatible tokenization between teacher and reference for aligned token-level log-probabilities, limiting application across tokenizer-incompatible models.
limits.zh: 要求教师与参考模型具备兼容的 tokenization，才能对齐 token 级对数概率，限制了在 tokenizer 不兼容模型上的应用。

limits.en: Developed for the frozen offline replay of Lightning OPD; direct applicability to fully online cross-teacher distillation is not empirically tested.
limits.zh: 该方法针对 Lightning OPD 的冻结离线回放开发；是否能直接用于完全在线的跨教师蒸馏尚未经实验验证。

limits.en: Only two cross-teacher settings and one OPD teacher are tested; Klear uses a diagnostic proxy, not an exact teacher-consistent signal.
limits.zh: 仅测试了两个跨教师设置和一个 OPD 教师；Klear 设置使用诊断代理，而非精确的教师一致信号。

items.en: Han Cai (hcai@nvidia.com).
items.zh: Han Cai (hcai@nvidia.com).

full.sec: Lightning OPD 2.0: Mitigating Style Bias in Cross-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
full.secZh: Lightning OPD 2.0：大型推理模型跨教师在线蒸馏中的风格偏差缓解

items.en: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but its effectiveness can depend on teacher consistency, meaning that the model providing OPD supervision should also have generated the demonstrations used to train the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) reference. However, this condition is frequently violated in practice when SFT data have mixed or unknown provenance or when different models are preferred for SFT data generation and subsequent distillation. In such cross-teacher settings, even a stronger OPD teacher can yield little improvement over the SFT reference. We find that raw teacher–reference disagreement contains potentially useful context-specific teacher evidence as well as a recurring component associated with differences in wording, formatting, and reasoning cadence. We introduce Lightning OPD 2.0 with cross-fitted style residualization, which uses rollout-level cross-fitting to estimate this recurring component as an operational proxy for style-token bias and subtracts it before constructing the token-level OPD update. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, Lightning OPD 2.0 consistently outperforms Lightning OPD in cross-teacher settings. Starting from Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT, Lightning OPD 2.0 reaches \(82.4\%\) on AIME 2024 and \(63.0\%\) on LiveCodeBench v5. Together, these results establish Lightning OPD 2.0 as a practical approach to cross-teacher OPD, relaxing teacher consistency as a prerequisite and allowing the SFT data generator and distillation teacher to be selected independently. Code will be released soon.

items.en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become an effective post-training alternative to reinforcement learning for large language models (LLMs). Rather than learning from a sparse sequence-level reward, OPD utilizes a high-capability teacher to score student-generated trajectories and converts teacher–student disagreement into dense token-level supervision. This dense on-policy supervision makes OPD a stable and cost-effective alternative to reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), while maintaining strong performance across reasoning tasks.
items.zh: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）已成为大语言模型（LLMs）后训练中替代强化学习的有效方案。OPD 不是从稀疏的序列级奖励中学习，而是利用高能力教师模型对学生模型生成的轨迹进行评分，并将教师与学生之间的分歧转化为密集的 token 级监督。这种密集的在线策略监督使 OPD 成为基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）的一种稳定且高性价比的替代方案，同时能在各类推理任务上保持强劲性能。

items.en: Standard OPD nevertheless requires a live teacher throughout training. We introduce Lightning OPD, which removes this systems bottleneck by precomputing both the rollouts from the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) reference policy and their corresponding teacher log-probabilities before training, then reusing the resulting cache throughout optimization. A central finding of that work is that effective OPD requires teacher consistency. This condition means that the teacher used for OPD is the same model that generated the demonstrations used to train the SFT reference policy. Teacher consistency aligns the token-level distillation signal with the behavior already learned by the reference policy, which allows fully offline Lightning OPD to closely track standard online OPD. This consideration is not unique to the offline formulation. Standard OPD also begins from an SFT policy shaped by its demonstration teacher. Selecting a different OPD teacher can therefore introduce the cross-teacher mismatch even though rollouts and teacher scores are collected online.
items.zh: 然而，标准 OPD 在整个训练过程中都需要一个实时教师模型。我们提出 Lightning OPD，通过在训练前预先计算来自监督微调（SFT）参考策略的轨迹及其对应的教师对数概率，然后在优化过程中复用所生成的缓存，从而消除这一系统瓶颈。该工作的一个核心发现是，有效的 OPD 需要教师一致性。这一条件意味着，用于 OPD 的教师模型必须与生成用于训练 SFT 参考策略的演示数据的模型相同。教师一致性使 token 级蒸馏信号与参考策略已学到的行为对齐，从而让完全离线的 Lightning OPD 能够紧密跟踪标准的在线 OPD。这一考虑并非离线方案所独有。标准 OPD 同样从一个由其演示教师塑造的 SFT 策略开始。因此，即使轨迹和教师分数是在线收集的，选择不同的 OPD 教师也可能引入跨教师不匹配。

items.en: However, teacher consistency is often difficult to satisfy in practice. Available SFT data may have mixed or undocumented provenance and may have been generated by several different models, leaving no single demonstration teacher that can be reused consistently during OPD. Even when the original data generator is known, practitioners may want to reuse an existing SFT dataset rather than incur the substantial cost of regenerating demonstrations with every candidate teacher and repeating SFT. More fundamentally, teacher consistency couples the choice of the SFT data generator with the choice of the OPD teacher, even though the best models for these two roles need not be the same. The intended OPD teacher may not be the most suitable model for generating SFT demonstrations. Practitioners may instead use a stronger generator to produce higher-quality demonstrations and obtain a stronger SFT reference policy, while selecting a different teacher for later distillation to maximize the overall post-training result. Enforcing consistency in these settings would require rebuilding the SFT pipeline or compromising one stage to accommodate the other. The practical goal is therefore to preserve the strongest available SFT reference while retaining the freedom to choose the most suitable teacher for subsequent OPD.
items.zh: 然而，在实践中，教师一致性往往难以满足。可用的 SFT 数据可能来源混杂或来源不明，并且可能由多个不同模型生成，从而不存在一个可以在 OPD 过程中一致复用的单一演示教师。即使原始数据生成器已知，从业者也可能希望复用现有的 SFT 数据集，而不愿为每个候选教师重新生成演示并重复 SFT 承担高昂成本。更根本地，教师一致性将 SFT 数据生成器的选择与 OPD 教师的选择耦合在一起，而这两个角色的最佳模型未必相同。预期的 OPD 教师可能并不是生成 SFT 演示的最合适模型。从业者可能会使用更强的生成器来产生更高质量的演示，从而获得更强的 SFT 参考策略，同时选择另一个教师进行后续蒸馏，以最大化整体后训练效果。在这些情况下强制一致性，将需要重建 SFT 流程，或者牺牲某一阶段来迁就另一阶段。因此，实践目标是在保留最强的可用 SFT 参考策略的同时，保留为后续 OPD 选择最合适教师的自由度。

items.en: To this end, our goal is to remove teacher consistency as a practical prerequisite for effective OPD and decouple the choice of the SFT data generator from that of the OPD teacher while still achieving reliable post-training performance across different teacher combinations. However, naively replacing the consistent teacher with a different OPD teacher substantially degrades performance, even when the new teacher is stronger.
items.zh: 为此，我们的目标是消除教师一致性作为有效 OPD 的实际前提，并将 SFT 数据生成器的选择与 OPD 教师的选择解耦，同时在不同教师组合下依然实现可靠的后训练性能。然而，即使新教师更强，简单地将一致的教师替换为不同的 OPD 教师也会显著降低性能。

items.en: To understand this degradation, we consider the role of each token in the response. Some tokens carry problem-specific reasoning, whereas others primarily express the response’s style. On reasoning-related tokens, a low probability from the OPD teacher may identify an incorrect intermediate conclusion, operation, or reasoning direction and thereby provide useful corrective supervision. On style tokens, however, the same low probability may instead reflect a preference for different wording, transitions, formatting, derivation length, or reasoning cadence, even when the reference trajectory remains valid. Lightning OPD cannot distinguish these cases and converts both into the same token-level update. Because style choices appear throughout a response and similar preferences recur across rollouts, their accumulated penalties may systematically interfere with the more context-specific reasoning signal. This difference also suggests an observable statistical proxy. Disagreement associated with style tokens is more likely to recur across unrelated rollouts through similar lexical choices, response positions, and levels of reference-policy surprisal, whereas reasoning-related disagreement depends more strongly on the current problem and reasoning state. We therefore treat the component that is predictable across cached rollouts as a proxy for style-token bias and the remaining residual as a candidate carrier of reasoning-related teacher evidence. These terms describe the roles that motivate our method rather than a ground-truth semantic partition, and our procedure does not assume that every predictable effect is style or that every residual reflects correct reasoning.
items.zh: 为了理解这种性能下降，我们考察响应中每个 token 的角色。有些 token 承载与具体问题相关的推理，而另一些 token 主要表达响应的风格。在与推理相关的 token 上，OPD 教师给出的低概率可能识别出错误的中间结论、运算或推理方向，从而提供有用的纠正性监督。然而，在风格 token 上，同样的低概率可能只是反映出对措辞、过渡、格式、推导长度或推理节奏的不同偏好，即使参考轨迹仍然有效。Lightning OPD 无法区分这两种情况，并将二者转换为相同的 token 级更新。由于风格选择出现在整个响应中，且相似偏好会在不同轨迹中重复出现，这些累积的惩罚可能系统性地干扰更依赖具体上下文的推理信号。这一差异还提示了一个可观测的统计代理。与风格 token 相关的分歧更可能通过相似的词汇选择、响应位置和参考策略的惊讶度在不同无关轨迹中反复出现，而与推理相关的分歧则更强烈地依赖于当前问题和推理状态。因此，我们将跨缓存轨迹可预测的成分视为风格 token 偏差的代理，将剩余残差视为可能承载与推理相关教师证据的候选。这些术语描述的是激发我们方法的角色，而非关于语义的真实划分；我们的流程也不假设每个可预测效应都是风格，或每个残差都反映正确推理。

items.en: Based on this observation, we introduce Lightning OPD 2.0 with cross-fitted style residualization. We first compute the token-level log-probability difference between the OPD teacher and the SFT reference. We then split the cached rollouts into folds and use the other folds to construct two lookup tables, one indexed by token identity and the other by normalized response position and reference-policy surprisal. Averaging the two lookup values gives each held-out token an estimate of its recurring style bias without using its own rollout. We subtract this estimate from the raw difference and use the residual in place of the original disagreement in the Lightning OPD objective.
items.zh: 基于这一观察，我们引入了带有交叉拟合风格残差化的 Lightning OPD 2.0。我们首先计算 OPD 教师模型与 SFT 参考模型之间的 token 级对数概率差。然后，我们将缓存的 rollout 数据划分为若干折（folds），并利用其他折构建两个查找表：一个以 token 身份为索引，另一个以归一化响应位置和参考策略的惊奇度（surprisal）为索引。将两个查找值的平均值作为每个留出（held-out）token 的重复风格偏差估计，而不使用其自身的 rollout。我们从原始差值中减去该估计值，并在 Lightning OPD 目标中使用残差替代原始的不一致项。

items.en: Using Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 as the OPD teacher, we evaluate Lightning OPD 2.0 on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks with Qwen3-4B-SFT and Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT as two distinct SFT references. Lightning OPD 2.0 consistently outperforms Lightning OPD in both settings. It improves average mathematical reasoning performance by \(3.1\) and \(1.0\) points, respectively, and average code generation performance by \(1.4\) points in both settings. Starting from Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT, Lightning OPD 2.0 reaches \(82.4\%\) on AIME 2024 and \(63.0\%\) on LiveCodeBench v5.
items.zh: 以 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 作为 OPD 教师模型，我们在数学推理和代码生成基准上评估 Lightning OPD 2.0，并使用 Qwen3-4B-SFT 和 Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT 作为两个不同的 SFT 参考模型。Lightning OPD 2.0 在两种设置下均持续优于 Lightning OPD。在平均数学推理性能上分别提高了 3.1 和 1.0 个百分点，在平均代码生成性能上两种设置均提高了 1.4 个百分点。从 Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT 出发，Lightning OPD 2.0 在 AIME 2024 上达到 82.4%，在 LiveCodeBench v5 上达到 63.0%。

items.en: Our contributions are threefold.
items.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。

items.en: We formulate the cross-teacher OPD setting, in which the SFT data generator and the OPD teacher are selected independently, and show that distillation effects can substantially degrade under this setting.
items.zh: 我们形式化了跨教师 OPD 设置，在该设置中，SFT 数据生成器和 OPD 教师模型被独立选择，并表明蒸馏效果在这种设置下可能大幅劣化。

items.en: We identify a recurring component of teacher-reference disagreement that is predictable across rollouts and associated with style-token bias, explaining why raw cross-teacher supervision can be misleading.
items.zh: 我们识别了教师-参考模型不一致中一个可预测的、跨 rollouts 重复出现的成分，该成分与风格 token 偏差相关，从而解释了为什么原始跨教师监督可能具有误导性。

items.en: We introduce Lightning OPD 2.0, which estimates this recurring component with cross-fitted token and context lookup tables and subtracts it before applying the Lightning OPD update. Across two cross-teacher settings, Lightning OPD 2.0 consistently improves Lightning OPD on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks and achieves state-of-the-art performance.
items.zh: 我们引入了 Lightning OPD 2.0，它通过交叉拟合的词元查找表和上下文查找表来估计这一重复出现的成分，并在应用 Lightning OPD 更新之前将其减去。在两种跨教师设置下，Lightning OPD 2.0 在数学推理和代码生成基准测试中持续优于 Lightning OPD，并达到了最先进的性能。

items.en: Post-training is central to capable LLMs, commonly combining supervised fine-tuning on high-quality instruction and reasoning demonstrations with preference- and reward-based optimization. For reasoning, recent methods develop outcome-based policy optimization and improve process-level credit assignment or value learning. These advances support increasingly capable mathematical and general reasoning systems. Complementary analyses study what online optimization adds beyond SFT and why it can better preserve existing capabilities, while recent methods co-design or interleave SFT and RL. Our work instead studies the coupling between the model that generates the SFT demonstrations and the teacher that provides subsequent OPD supervision, seeking to remove teacher consistency as a practical prerequisite for effective OPD.
items.zh: 后训练对于构建强大的大语言模型至关重要，通常将基于高质量指令与推理演示的监督微调，与基于偏好和奖励的优化相结合。在推理方面，近期方法发展了基于结果的策略优化，并改进了过程级信用分配或价值学习。这些进展支撑了日益强大的数学与通用推理系统。互补性分析研究了在线优化在 SFT 之外带来了什么，以及为何它能更好地保留既有能力，而近期方法则共同设计或将 SFT 与 RL 交替使用。我们的工作转而研究生成 SFT 演示的模型与提供后续 OPD 监督的教师之间的耦合，力求消除“教师一致性”作为有效 OPD 的实际前提。

items.en: Knowledge distillation transfers capabilities from a teacher to a student by matching their output distributions. Sequence-level and language-model distillation extend this idea to autoregressive generation, whereas on-policy distillation evaluates the teacher on student-generated trajectories and provides dense feedback on states visited by the student. Recent work extends OPD through reward extrapolation and flexible reference policies, entropy-aware divergence and local-support matching, reinforcement-aware or verifier-guided objectives, controllable reasoning, and black-box, privileged, or self-distillation settings. OPD has also become a component of large-scale reasoning post-training pipelines. Complementary studies show that stronger teachers do not always yield better students and trace failures to thinking-pattern incompatibility, unreliable token-level guidance, and teacher-dependent gradient quality. Offline OPD variants avoid maintaining a live teacher during optimization by precomputing rollouts and their corresponding teacher log-probabilities before training. Building upon Lightning OPD, we study how to maintain effective distillation in cross-teacher settings, where the SFT data generator and the OPD teacher differ. Lightning OPD 2.0 uses rollout-level cross-fitting to estimate the recurring component of teacher–reference disagreement as an operational proxy for style-token bias and subtracts it before constructing the token-level OPD update.
items.zh: 知识蒸馏通过匹配教师模型与学生模型的输出分布，将能力从教师迁移到学生。序列级和语言模型蒸馏将该思想扩展到自回归生成，而在策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）则在学生生成的轨迹上评估教师，并对学生访问过的状态提供密集反馈。近期工作通过奖励外推与灵活参考策略、熵感知散度与局部支持匹配、强化感知或验证器引导的目标、可控推理，以及黑盒、特权或自蒸馏设置来扩展 OPD。OPD 也已成为大规模推理后训练流程的组成部分。补充研究表明，更强的教师并不总能带来更好的学生，并将失败归因于思维模式不兼容、不可靠的词元级引导，以及依赖教师的梯度质量。离线 OPD 变体通过在训练前预计算轨迹及其对应的教师对数概率，避免了优化过程中维持实时教师。基于 Lightning OPD，我们研究如何在交叉教师设置中维持有效的蒸馏，即 SFT 数据生成器与 OPD 教师不同。Lightning OPD 2.0 使用轨迹级交叉拟合来估计教师-参考分歧中的周期性成分，作为风格词元偏差的操作性代理，并在构建词元级 OPD 更新之前将其减去。

items.en: Let \(p\) be the training-prompt distribution and \(\{q_i\}_{i=1}^{N}\) the prompts stored in the replay. When the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) demonstrations have a single identifiable generator, let \(\pi_{G}\) denote this SFT data generator. Let \(\pi_{R}\) be the resulting SFT reference policy, \(\pi_{T}\) the model selected to provide OPD supervision, and \(\pi_{\theta}\) a trainable policy initialized from \(\pi_{R}\). Teacher consistency requires \(\pi_{T}=\pi_{G}\). We study cross-teacher OPD, where \(\pi_{T}\) is selected independently of \(\pi_{G}\) or no single \(\pi_{G}\) can be identified. Our method addresses this general setting through the frozen replay of Lightning OPD.
items.zh: 设 \(p\) 为训练提示分布，\(\{q_i\}_{i=1}^{N}\) 为存储于回放中的提示。当监督微调（SFT）演示具有单一可辨识的生成器时，令 \(\pi_{G}\) 表示该 SFT 数据生成器。令 \(\pi_{R}\) 为所得的 SFT 参考策略，\(\pi_{T}\) 为被选中提供 OPD 监督的模型，\(\pi_{\theta}\) 为从 \(\pi_{R}\) 初始化的可训练策略。教师一致性要求 \(\pi_{T}=\pi_{G}\)。我们研究跨教师 OPD，其中 \(\pi_{T}\) 独立于 \(\pi_{G}\) 选择，或者无法辨识出单一的 \(\pi_{G}\)。我们的方法通过 Lightning OPD 的冻结回放来处理这一通用设置。

items.en: Following Lightning OPD, we sample and freeze one response \(x_i = (y_{i1}, \ldots, y_{iL_i}) \sim \pi_R(\cdot \mid q_i)\) for every prompt. Let \(h_{it} = (q_i, y_{i,<t})\) be the prefix at token \(t\). The OPD teacher and the SFT reference score the same realized token, producing the cached chosen-token log-probabilities.
items.zh: 遵循 Lightning OPD，我们为每个提示采样并冻结一个响应 \(x_i = (y_{i1}, \ldots, y_{iL_i}) \sim \pi_R(\cdot \mid q_i)\)。令 \(h_{it} = (q_i, y_{i,<t})\) 为第 \(t\) 个词元处的前缀。OPD 教师和 SFT 参考对相同的实际词元进行评分，产生缓存的被选中词元对数概率。

items.en: We assume that these scores are aligned to the same response tokens. Our experiments use models with compatible Qwen-family tokenization.
items.zh: 我们假设这些分数与相同的响应词元对齐。我们的实验使用具有兼容 Qwen 系列词元化方式的模型。

items.en: Using this cache, unmodified Lightning OPD retains the original per-token advantage.
items.zh: 利用该缓存，未修改的 Lightning OPD 保留原始的逐词元优势。

items.en: Following standard OPD practice, the advantage is treated as a fixed scalar when computing parameter updates. Throughout this section, \(\nabla J\) denotes the resulting advantage-weighted policy gradient rather than ordinary differentiation through the advantage. We use the same policy surrogate as Lightning OPD.
items.zh: 遵循标准 OPD 实践，在计算参数更新时将优势视为固定标量。在本节中，\(\nabla J\) 表示所得的优势加权策略梯度，而不是对优势进行普通微分。我们使用与 Lightning OPD 相同的策略替代。

items.en: To isolate the part of the signal affected by the teacher choice, we define the teacher–reference disagreement.
items.zh: 为了隔离受教师选择影响的那部分信号，我们定义了教师-参考分歧。

items.en: At initialization, \(\pi_{\theta}=\pi_{R}\), so \(A^{\mathrm{base}}_{it}=d_{it}\). In cross-teacher OPD, \(d_{it}\) can contain both context-specific teacher evidence and recurring teacher–reference differences induced by the mismatch with the SFT data generator. The unmodified update cannot distinguish the two. The next subsection develops an operational proxy for this recurring component.
items.zh: 在初始化时，\(\pi_{\theta}=\pi_{R}\)，因此 \(A^{\mathrm{base}}_{it}=d_{it}\)。在跨教师 OPD 中，\(d_{it}\) 既可能包含特定于上下文的教师证据，也可能包含由与 SFT 数据生成器不匹配所引起的反复出现的教师-参考差异。未修改的更新无法区分这两者。下一小节将为这一反复出现的成分开发一个可操作的代理。

full.sec: 3.2 Predictability across Rollouts as a Style Proxy
full.secZh: 3.2 跨 rollout 的可预测性作为风格代理

items.capEn: Figure 2: Overview of Lightning OPD 2.0. The SFT reference generates the frozen rollouts, which are scored by both the reference and the independently selected OPD teacher to obtain the raw teacher–reference disagreement. For each held-out fold, response-balanced token and context lookup tables fitt

items.en: The raw disagreement \(d_{it}\) can contain both context-specific teacher evidence and systematic differences in how the selected teacher and the SFT reference express a response. We make the operational assumption that disagreement associated with recurring style differences is more predictable across cached rollouts from simple lexical and coarse contextual coordinates, whereas potentially useful, reasoning-related teacher evidence is more dependent on the current context. We therefore write
items.zh: 原始分歧 \(d_{it}\) 可能既包含特定于上下文的教师证据，也包含所选教师与 SFT 参考在表达回应时的系统性差异。我们做出操作性假设：与重复出现的风格差异相关的分歧，在缓存的 rollout 中，通过简单的词汇和粗略的上下文坐标更可预测；而可能有用的、与推理相关的教师证据则更依赖于当前上下文。因此我们写为

items.en: where \(z_{it}\) collects the token and context coordinates defined below, \(b(z_{it})\) is the component that recurs at those coordinates across rollouts, and \(v_{it}\) is the remaining variation. This is an operational decomposition rather than a semantic labeling of individual tokens. We use \(b(z_{it})\) as a proxy for recurring style-token bias and approximate it by equally combining token- and context-based lookup predictions. We estimate these predictions by rollout-level cross-fitting and replace \(d_{it}\) with its estimated residual in the training objective.
items.zh: 其中 \(z_{it}\) 收集下文定义的 token 和上下文坐标，\(b(z_{it})\) 是在这些坐标上跨 rollout 重复出现的分量，\(v_{it}\) 是剩余的变化。这是一种操作性分解，而非对单个 token 的语义标注。我们使用 \(b(z_{it})\) 作为重复出现的风格 token 偏差的代理，并通过等权组合基于 token 和基于上下文的查找预测来近似它。我们通过 rollout 层面的交叉拟合来估计这些预测，并在训练目标中用 \(d_{it}\) 的估计残差替换 \(d_{it}\)。

full.secZh: 反复出现分歧的可观测坐标

items.en: Estimating a component that recurs across rollouts requires coordinates that are shared often enough to support reliable averaging but expressive enough to distinguish different uses of a token. Token identity captures lexical preference but treats every occurrence alike. At the other extreme, the full prefix identifies the local context precisely but rarely repeats across rollouts and may absorb problem-specific reasoning. We therefore complement token identity with a coarse context coordinate based on normalized response position and reference-policy surprisal. Normalized response position identifies the stage of the response. Reference-policy surprisal provides a low-dimensional summary of how typical the realized token is under the SFT reference, rather than a direct indicator of style. Together, these coordinates describe broad usage conditions without conditioning on the full prompt or prefix.
items.zh: 估计跨 rollout 重复出现的组件需要这样的坐标：它们既要足够频繁地共享以支持可靠的均值估计，又要具有足够的表达力来区分词元的不同用法。词元身份捕获词汇偏好，但将所有出现同等对待。在另一个极端，完整前缀能精确识别局部上下文，但在 rollout 之间很少重复，而且可能吸收特定于问题的推理。因此，我们用基于归一化响应位置和参考策略意外度（reference-policy surprisal）的粗粒度上下文坐标来补充词元身份。归一化响应位置标识响应所处的阶段。参考策略意外度提供了一个低维摘要，描述实际词元在 SFT 参考模型下的典型程度，而非风格的直接指标。这些坐标共同描述了广泛的使用条件，而无需以完整提示或前缀为条件。

items.en: Formally, let the reference-policy surprisal be \(\xi_{it} = -\ell^{R}_{it}\), the standard measure of how atypical a realized token is under a language model. A small value means that the token is natural under the SFT reference, while a large value means that the reference itself finds the token unexpected. We divide the response into \(B_{\mathrm{pos}}\) normalized-position bins and the surprisal range into \(B_{\mathrm{ref}}\) bins up to \(\xi_{\max}\). Coarse surprisal bins distinguish disagreement on reference-typical and reference-atypical tokens while preserving sufficient support across rollouts for stable estimation. Their zero-indexed identifiers are
items.zh: 形式化地，令参考策略意外度为 \(\xi_{it} = -\ell^{R}_{it}\)，这是衡量实现词元在语言模型下有多不典型的标准指标。小值表示该词元在 SFT 参考模型下是自然的，而大值表示参考模型本身认为该词元出乎意料。我们将响应划分为 \(B_{\mathrm{pos}}\) 个归一化位置区间（bin），将意外度范围划分为 \(B_{\mathrm{ref}}\) 个区间，直至 \(\xi_{\max}\)。粗粒度的意外度区间可以区分参考典型词元和参考非典型词元上的分歧，同时保留足够的跨 rollout 支持以实现稳定估计。它们的从零开始的标识符为

items.en: We set \(z^{\mathrm{tok}}_{it} = y_{it}\), \(z^{\mathrm{ctx}}_{it} = (p_{it}, r_{it})\), and \(z_{it} = (z^{\mathrm{tok}}_{it}, z^{\mathrm{ctx}}_{it})\). Binning pools comparable occurrences across responses of different lengths. We construct the token and context lookup tables separately rather than using their full cross product, which avoids fragmenting the cache into excessively sparse groups.
items.zh: 我们令 \(z^{\mathrm{tok}}_{it} = y_{it}\)、\(z^{\mathrm{ctx}}_{it} = (p_{it}, r_{it})\)、\(z_{it} = (z^{\mathrm{tok}}_{it}, z^{\mathrm{ctx}}_{it})\)。分箱将不同长度响应中的可比较出现汇集到一起。我们分别构建词元和上下文查找表，而不是使用它们的完整笛卡尔积，这避免了将缓存切分成过于稀疏的组。

full.secZh: 3.3 重复分歧的交叉拟合估计

items.en: Cross-fitting is a standard sample-splitting technique for constructing held-out predictions and preventing self-fitting. We use it only as an estimation device. We partition the cached rollouts into \(K\) deterministic folds, keeping all rollouts originating from the same prompt in one fold. For a rollout in fold \(k\), we estimate all statistics using only the other \(K-1\) folds. Neither that rollout nor another rollout from the same prompt can therefore contribute to its lookup tables. This exclusion prevents self-fitting but does not by itself identify the predicted component as style.
items.zh: 交叉拟合是一种标准的样本切分技术，用于构造留出预测并防止自拟合。我们仅将其用作估计手段。我们将缓存的生成轨迹（rollouts）划分为 \(K\) 个确定性折（folds），并将来自同一提示（prompt）的所有轨迹放在同一折中。对于第 \(k\) 折中的一次轨迹，我们仅使用其余 \(K-1\) 折来估计所有统计量。因此，该轨迹以及来自同一提示的另一轨迹都不能对其查找表产生贡献。这种排除可以防止自拟合，但本身并不能将被预测的成分识别为风格。

items.en: To prevent longer responses from dominating the estimates, we assign each response a total weight of one, distributed uniformly over its active tokens, when fitting the lookup tables. The training loss uses the same reduction by averaging active-token contributions within each response and then averaging across responses. This response-balanced reduction is shared by all methods and is not a component of style residualization.
items.zh: 为了防止较长的响应在估计中占主导，我们在拟合查找表时为每个响应分配总权重 1，并将其均匀分布到其有效（active）token 上。训练损失采用相同的归约方式：先在每个响应内对有效 token 的贡献取平均，再在响应之间取平均。这种响应均衡的归约方式被所有方法共用，并不是风格残差化的组成部分。

items.en: Using the non-held-out folds, we build one lookup table for the mean disagreement of each token identity and another for each context coordinate. Rare groups are smoothed toward the global mean of the non-held-out folds, while unseen groups use that global mean directly. This prevents a rare token or context from receiving an unstable correction. Let \(m_{\mathrm{tok}}^{(-k)}\) and \(m_{\mathrm{ctx}}^{(-k)}\) denote the resulting smoothed lookup tables. For token \((i,t)\) in held-out fold \(k\), we use the equal-weight prediction
items.zh: 我们使用非留出折为每个 token 身份构建一个平均分歧查找表，并为每个上下文坐标构建另一个查找表。稀有组向非留出折的全局均值平滑，而未出现的组直接使用该全局均值。这可以防止稀有 token 或上下文获得不稳定的修正。令 \(m_{\mathrm{tok}}^{(-k)}\) 和 \(m_{\mathrm{ctx}}^{(-k)}\) 表示由此得到的平滑查找表。对于留出折 \(k\) 中的 token \((i,t)\)，我们使用等权预测

items.en: The two lookup predictions receive equal coefficients, and averaging keeps their combination on the scale of a single disagreement estimate. Equation (7) is our concrete approximation to \(b(z_{it})\) in Equation (5). At the conceptual level, both tables average the raw disagreement \(d_{it}\). Because both lookup tables exclude the current rollout, \(\widehat{b}_{it}\) captures recurring disagreement that is predictable from other cached rollouts rather than variation fitted specifically to the current response.
items.zh: 两个查找表预测获得相等的系数，取平均后其组合仍保持在单个分歧估计的尺度上。式 (7) 是我们对式 (5) 中 \(b(z_{it})\) 的具体近似。在概念层面，两个表都对原始分歧 \(d_{it}\) 取平均。由于两个查找表都排除了当前轨迹，\(\widehat{b}_{it}\) 捕获的是可从其他缓存轨迹预测的重复分歧，而非专门针对当前响应拟合的变异。

items.en: The base advantage separates into the cross-teacher disagreement \(d_{it}\) and a reference-anchoring term \(r_{it}\).
items.zh: 基础优势分解为跨教师分歧 \(d_{it}\) 和参考锚定项 \(r_{it}\)。

items.en: Because \(\widehat{b}_{it}\) estimates recurring teacher–reference disagreement, we residualize only \(d_{it}\) and leave the reference-anchoring term unchanged. We set \[d^{*}_{it}=d_{it}-\widehat{b}_{it}\].
items.zh: 由于 \(\widehat{b}_{it}\) 估计了反复出现的教师–参考分歧，我们仅对 \(d_{it}\) 进行残差化，并保持参考锚定项不变。我们令 \[d^{*}_{it}=d_{it}-\widehat{b}_{it}\]。

items.en: The resulting advantage is \[A^{\mathrm{res}}_{it}=d^{*}_{it}+r_{it}\].
items.zh: 由此得到的优势为 \[A^{\mathrm{res}}_{it}=d^{*}_{it}+r_{it}\]。

items.en: At initialization, \(\pi_{\theta}=\pi_{R}\) and \(A^{\mathrm{res}}_{it}=d^{*}_{it}\). We retain the Lightning OPD objective form while replacing the raw cross-teacher disagreement with its residualized counterpart.
items.zh: 在初始化时，\(\pi_{\theta}=\pi_{R}\)，且 \(A^{\mathrm{res}}_{it}=d^{*}_{it}\)。我们保留 Lightning OPD 目标形式，同时将原始跨教师分歧替换为其残差化版本。

items.en: Equivalently, at the conceptual objective level, we define the fixed effective chosen-token teacher score \(\widetilde{\ell}^{T}_{it}=\ell^{T}_{it}-\widehat{b}_{it}\) and use it in place of \(\ell^{T}_{it}\). This score and \(\widehat{b}_{it}\) are computed before training and remain fixed throughout optimization.
items.zh: 等价地，在概念性目标层面，我们定义固定的有效“选定词元教师分数” \(\widetilde{\ell}^{T}_{it}=\ell^{T}_{it}-\widehat{b}_{it}\)，并用它代替 \(\ell^{T}_{it}\)。该分数与 \(\widehat{b}_{it}\) 均在训练前计算，并在整个优化过程中保持不变。

items.en: Our experiments are organized into four parts. We first describe the two cross-teacher settings, training and evaluation protocols, and matched baselines. We then report the main results on mathematical reasoning and code generation under both settings. Next, we conduct a mechanism analysis that compares the cross-teacher training signal with its teacher-consistent counterpart and shows how Lightning OPD 2.0 removes the dominant style-token bias introduced by teacher inconsistency. Finally, we ablate the core algorithmic design points by removing the token-identity lookup, the context lookup, and prompt-level cross-fitting from the full method.
items.zh: 我们的实验分为四个部分。首先，我们描述两种跨教师设置、训练与评估协议以及匹配的基线。然后，我们报告在两种设置下数学推理和代码生成的主要结果。接下来，我们进行机制分析，将跨教师训练信号与其教师一致的对应信号进行比较，并展示 Lightning OPD 2.0 如何消除由教师不一致引入的主要风格词元偏差。最后，我们通过从完整方法中移除词元身份查找、上下文查找和提示级交叉拟合，来消融核心算法设计点。

items.en: We study two complementary settings. The Qwen3-4B setting starts from the Qwen3-4B SFT reference used by Lightning OPD, whose SFT demonstrations were generated by Qwen3-8B, and selects Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 as the OPD teacher. Its known provenance makes the source of cross-teacher style mismatch directly identifiable. The second setting uses Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT, which is trained from Qwen3-8B-Base using long-chain-of-thought SFT data distilled from DeepSeek-R1-0528. It tests whether the same correction applies to a stronger SFT reference trained from a different initialization and data generator. Both settings use Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 as the selected cross-teacher OPD teacher.
items.zh: 我们研究了两种互补的设置。Qwen3-4B 设置以 Lightning OPD 所使用的 Qwen3-4B SFT 参考模型为起点，其 SFT 演示数据由 Qwen3-8B 生成，并选择 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 作为 OPD 教师模型。该模型来源已知，因此可以明确识别跨教师风格不匹配的源头。第二种设置使用 Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT，该模型基于 Qwen3-8B-Base，使用从 DeepSeek-R1-0528 蒸馏出的长思维链 SFT 数据进行训练。它检验同样的修正是否适用于一个更强的 SFT 参考模型，该模型由不同的初始化和数据生成器训练而来。两种设置均选定 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 作为所选的跨教师 OPD 教师模型。

items.en: We train on two domains. Mathematical reasoning uses DAPO-Math-17k, which provides 17K competition-level math problems spanning a wide range of difficulty. Code generation uses KlearReasoner-CodeSub-15K, which provides 15K carefully cleaned and filtered code problems. For each OPD prompt, we sample a single response from the SFT reference and precompute the corresponding selected-teacher log-probabilities once before training, following the pipeline of Lightning OPD. We use five prompt-level folds for cross-fitting. The training framework is built upon slime, and we train each model for 150 steps using the Lightning OPD policy surrogate with a PPO clipping range of \(0.2\).
items.zh: 我们在两个领域上进行训练。数学推理使用 DAPO-Math-17k，它提供了 17K 个竞赛级数学问题，覆盖了广泛的难度范围。代码生成使用 KlearReasoner-CodeSub-15K，它提供了 15K 个经过仔细清洗和过滤的代码问题。对于每个 OPD 提示，我们从 SFT 参考中采样单个响应，并在训练前一次性预计算相应的所选教师对数概率，遵循 Lightning OPD 的流程。我们使用五个提示级别的折进行交叉拟合。训练框架基于 slime 构建，我们使用 Lightning OPD 策略替代（policy surrogate）训练每个模型 150 步，PPO 裁剪范围为 \(0.2\)。

items.en: For mathematical reasoning, we evaluate on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT February 2025. For code generation, we evaluate on LiveCodeBench v5 and v6. We set the temperature to \(0.6\) and top-\(p\) to \(0.95\) throughout. The maximum generation length is 40,960 for all math and code benchmarks. Math uses 64 solutions per problem and code uses 8 solutions per problem, and we report average Pass@1.
items.zh: 在数学推理方面，我们评估了 AIME 2024、AIME 2025 和 HMMT 2025 年 2 月的成绩。在代码生成方面，我们评估了 LiveCodeBench v5 和 v6。我们全程将温度设置为 \(0.6\)，top-\(p\) 设置为 \(0.95\)。所有数学和代码基准的最大生成长度为 40,960。数学每个问题使用 64 个解，代码每个问题使用 8 个解，我们报告平均 Pass@1。

items.en: We compare Lightning OPD 2.0 with the SFT reference and three OPD baselines. Lightning OPD applies the original token-level distillation objective without style correction. IW-OPD addresses position bias by weighting tokens according to the accumulated teacher–student discrepancy, while TA-OPD selects positions whose teacher signal is predicted to be learnable. For a controlled comparison, all OPD methods start from the same SFT reference and use the same rollouts, cached teacher log-probabilities, and training budget. Since IW-OPD and TA-OPD were originally formulated with online rollouts, we adapt their objectives to the frozen Lightning OPD replay.

items.en: Teacher consistency is central to effective OPD, yet it is often unavailable when an SFT reference and a later distillation teacher are selected independently. We study this cross-teacher setting and find that chosen-token disagreement contains potentially useful context-specific teacher evidence together with a recurring component that is predictable across cached rollouts and associated with differences in wording, formatting, and reasoning cadence. Lightning OPD 2.0 estimates this component from other cached rollouts as an operational proxy for style-token bias and subtracts it before the reference-anchored offline OPD update, leaving the residual signal to drive distillation. Across the Qwen3-4B-SFT and Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT settings, Lightning OPD 2.0 delivers consistent improvements over Lightning OPD on both mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. While our evaluation is limited to these tasks and Qwen-family models, the consistent gains establish Lightning OPD 2.0 as a practical framework for efficient and effective cross-teacher OPD, enabling the SFT reference and distillation teacher to be selected independently.
items.zh: 教师一致性对于有效的 OPD 至关重要，然而当 SFT 参考模型和后续的蒸馏教师模型被独立选择时，这种一致性往往无法获得。我们研究了这种跨教师设置，发现所选词元的不一致既包含潜在有用的、特定于上下文的教师证据，也包含一个可预测的、跨缓存回滚的重复成分，该成分与措辞、格式和推理节奏的差异相关。Lightning OPD 2.0 从其他缓存回滚中估计该成分，将其作为风格词元偏差的操作性代理，并在基于参考模型的离线 OPD 更新之前将其减去，从而让残差信号驱动蒸馏。在 Qwen3-4B-SFT 和 Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT 的设置下，Lightning OPD 2.0 在数学推理和代码生成任务上相较于 Lightning OPD 均取得了一致的改进。尽管我们的评估仅限于这些任务和 Qwen 系列模型，但一致的增益使 Lightning OPD 2.0 成为一个实用框架，能够高效且有效地进行跨教师 OPD，使 SFT 参考模型和蒸馏教师模型可以被独立选择。
